It’s like a subtle psychological " uniform of competence" that primes your brain to feel more capable, focused, and self-assured. Confidence is powerful, and if this outfit helps you step into your best self, that’s a wonderful thing! I’d love to hear more about how it impacts your day-to-life—does it change how you carry yourself in meetings, conversations, or even just your mood? 😊
